AGENDA CHANGES *3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - MATTERS NOT ON THE AGENDA
PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS
1.
PC8-266 - Core Development Services/Verizon Wireless (Continued from Planning Commission meeting of 3/17/15) A request for a Special Use Permit (height) to allow for a 50 foot high Verizon
Wireless faux eucalyptus tree cellular communications tower and associated
equipment enclosures near an existing industrial building located at 450 West
California Avenue. The proposed project is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15303, which allows for the construction and location of limited numbers of new, small facilities or structures and the installation of new equipment and facilities in small structures.
2.
PC20-124 -- City of Vista An amendment to Chapter 18.02 of the Development Code to define the term "Massage Establishment." This amendment is exempt from environmental review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) in accordance with Section 15061 of the CEQA Guidelines.
A1.
